description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger Your Marked quarry attempts a reaction (such as an attack of opportunity) against you or your Feral Bond, or spends an action to move adjacent to either of you

The quarry must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or that action is wasted outright — it swings at empty air or moves to the wrong square.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'; target:mark:quarry is live). This card's real blocker is independent: no rule element retroactively cancels or nullifies an opponent's already-declared action based on a save -- confirmed absent (the closest documented absence of this general category of post-hoc override is that no rule element retroactively redefines an already-rolled die's numeric value either).
